answer_1.quote: To assess the effectiveness of the bit configurations discovered by AMQ, we utilized AWQ , a well-established weight-only quantization method, following its original settings except for asymmetric clipping . AMQ utilized a group size of 128 for search and performance evaluation. We further compared AMQ with PB-LLM  and Bit-Stack  under varying memory constraints, and also with fixed-precision quantization methods, GPTQ and AWQ. We evaluate the optimized models by reporting language-modeling perplexity (PPL) on the WikiText-2 test set and the C4 validation set . For zero-shot performance, we use the LM-Evaluation-Harness  on six benchmarks: ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy , PIQA , , BoolQ , and WinoGrande .
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates compressed LLMs on zero-shot and few-shot natural language generation tasks, including question answering and reasoning, using standard benchmarks.
